Evaluator.description_en: The evaluator configuration in an evaluation task. Used to reference a previously created evaluator or to describe an inline evaluator for the current task
Evaluator.description_zh: 评估任务中的评估器配置，用于引用已创建的评估器，或以内联方式描述本次任务使用的评估器

config.description_en: The runtime configuration of the evaluator. For inline LLM evaluators, this must include configurations such as prompt. When referencing an existing evaluator, this parameter is typically not required and should only be specified when runtime parameters such as version need to be set
config.description_zh: 评估器运行配置。内联 LLM 评估器需要包含 prompt 等配置；引用已有评估器时通常不传，仅在需要指定版本等运行时参数时传入
config.title: 评估器配置（如prompt等）

evaluatorRef.description_en: The reference name of a registered evaluator. When specified, the evaluator definition is loaded by this reference with higher priority. Both built-in evaluators and custom evaluators are supported
evaluatorRef.description_zh: 已注册评估器的引用名称。传入后优先按该引用加载评估器定义，支持内置评估器和自定义评估器
evaluatorRef.title: 评估器引用ID（引用已注册评估器时使用）

filters.description_en: The evaluator-level data filter conditions. These take effect together with the task-level dataFilter.query
filters.description_zh: 评估器级数据筛选条件，会与任务级 dataFilter.query 共同生效
filters.title: 数据筛选条件

name.description_en: The evaluator name. Required for inline evaluators when evaluatorRef is not specified. The evaluatorRef or name must be unique within the same task
name.description_zh: 评估器名称。未传 evaluatorRef 的内联评估器场景必填；同一任务内 evaluatorRef 或 name 不能重复
name.title: 评估器名称

resultName.description_en: The field name for the evaluation result. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the metricName defined in the evaluator definition is used if this parameter is not specified
resultName.description_zh: 评估结果字段名。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传则使用评估器定义中的 metricName
resultName.title: 评分名称

resultType.description_en: The evaluation result type. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, defaults to score if not specified
resultType.description_zh: 评估结果类型。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传默认为 score
resultType.title: 结果类型：score / binary / text

type.description_en: The evaluator type. Defaults to LLM if not specified. Inline CODE evaluators are not currently supported. For the CODE type, reference a previously created evaluator by using evaluatorRef
type.description_zh: 评估器类型。未传时默认 LLM；内联 CODE 评估器当前不支持，CODE 类型请通过 evaluatorRef 引用已创建评估器
type.title: 评估器类型：LLM / CODE

additionalProperties.description_en: The extraction rule for a single variable. The key is the evaluator variable name, and the value consists of three parts: the source field originField, the extraction method type, and the extraction expression expression. Trace variables managed by the engine, such as agent_trajectory, agent_trajectory_full, session_trajectory, tool_context, and rag_context, do not support extraction rule configuration
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单个变量的提取规则，键为评估器变量名，值由被提取字段 originField、提取方式 type 和提取表达式 expression 三部分组成。agent_trajectory、agent_trajectory_full、session_trajectory、tool_context、rag_context 等由引擎接管的轨迹变量不支持配置提取规则

expression.description_en: The extraction expression. Its meaning is determined by type. When type is jsonpath, specify a JSONPath expression. You can use either a relative path relative to originField (such as $.order.expected) or an absolute path from the root (such as $trace.output.order.expected). When type is regex, specify a regular expression. Note that backslashes must be escaped in JSON. The expression syntax is validated upon saving. For regular expressions, RE2 compatibility is additionally validated. Patterns such as lookahead assertions, lookbehind assertions, backreferences, named groups, atomic groups, and possessive quantifiers are rejected
expression.description_zh: 提取表达式，含义由 type 决定。type=jsonpath 时填 JSONPath，既可写相对于 originField 的相对路径（$.order.expected），也可写从根开始的绝对路径（$trace.output.order.expected）；type=regex 时填正则表达式，注意 JSON 中反斜杠需转义。保存时会校验表达式语法，正则还会额外校验 RE2 兼容性，前后向断言、反向引用、命名组、原子组、占有量词等写法会被拒绝
expression.title: 提取表达式

originField.description_en: The evaluation data field from which content is extracted. The extraction expression is applied to the content of this field. Required when saving with the evaluation task. For the trial run API, this parameter can be omitted and the backend derives it from the expression. Multiple variables can share the same source field
originField.description_zh: 被提取的评估数据字段，提取表达式作用于该字段的内容。随评估任务保存时必填（试跑接口可缺省，由后端从表达式推导）；多个变量可以共用同一个源字段
originField.title: 被提取的评估数据字段

type.description_en: The extraction method. jsonpath extracts values from the JSON content of the field by using JSONPath. regex performs regular expression matching on the full text of the field. When capturing groups are present, the first capturing group is returned. When no capturing group is present, the entire match is returned
type.description_zh: 提取方式。jsonpath 表示在字段的 JSON 内容上按 JSONPath 取值；regex 表示在字段的完整文本上按正则匹配，含捕获组时取第一个捕获组，不含捕获组时取整段匹配
type.title: 提取方式：jsonpath / regex

variableExtractorMapping.description_en: The variable extraction rule mapping that maps evaluator variables to a portion of the content within an evaluation data field. This is applicable when the variable value is not the entire field but a subset of the field content. This parameter shares the same variable name key space as variableMapping. Each variable can use only one of the two. Duplicate configurations cause an error. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition. Call ListTraceFieldExtractionsPreview to perform a trial run for validation before saving
variableExtractorMapping.description_zh: 变量提取规则映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段内容中的一部分，适用于变量值不是整个字段、而是字段内容里的一小块的场景。与 variableMapping 共用同一变量名键空间，同一变量只能二选一，重复配置会报错；引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中。可先调用 ListTraceFieldExtractionsPreview 试跑验证后再保存

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a single variable mapping, indicating the evaluation data field path from which the evaluator variable reads
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单个变量映射值，表示该评估器变量读取的评估数据字段路径

variableMapping.description_en: The variable mapping that maps evaluator variables to evaluation data fields. Required for LLM/AGENT inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition
variableMapping.description_zh: 变量映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段。LLM/AGENT 内联评估器必填，引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中
variableMapping.title: 变量映射

endpointConnectorId.description_zh: 端点连接器ID（user/agent模式时必填）
endpointConnectorId.title: 端点连接器ID（user/agent模式时必填）

modelProvider.description_zh: 模型提供商：dashscope（默认）/ user / agent
modelProvider.title: 模型提供商：dashscope（默认）/ user / agent

promptTemplate.description_zh: Prompt消息模板，支持{{变量名}}占位符
promptTemplate.title: Prompt消息模板，支持{{变量名}}占位符

requestBodyTemplate.description_zh: Agent请求体模板（agent模式时必填，支持{{变量名}}）
requestBodyTemplate.title: Agent请求体模板（agent模式时必填，支持{{变量名}}）

querySql.description_zh: dataset-partial 模式下的自定义查询SQL子句
querySql.title: dataset-partial 模式下的自定义查询SQL子句

selectedItemIds.description_zh: dataset-partial 模式下选定的数据项ID列表
selectedItemIds.title: dataset-partial 模式下选定的数据项ID列表

frequencyPenalty.description_zh: 频率惩罚，正值减少重复，范围-2.0到2.0
frequencyPenalty.title: 频率惩罚，正值减少重复，范围-2.0到2.0

presencePenalty.description_zh: 存在惩罚，正值鼓励新话题，范围-2.0到2.0
presencePenalty.title: 存在惩罚，正值鼓励新话题，范围-2.0到2.0

stopSequences.description_zh: 停止序列，遇到时立即停止生成
stopSequences.title: 停止序列，遇到时立即停止生成

temperature.description_zh: 温度参数，控制输出随机性，范围0-2
temperature.title: 温度参数，控制输出随机性，范围0-2

topK.description_zh: Top K 采样参数，范围1-100
topK.title: Top K 采样参数，范围1-100

topP.description_zh: Top P 采样参数，范围0-1
topP.title: Top P 采样参数，范围0-1

content.description_zh: 内容，支持{{变量名}}占位符
content.title: 内容，支持{{变量名}}占位符
